card.name: Chhayam
card.tagline: Khmer comic drum procession of clowns and clappers
card.profile: Chhayam (ឆៃយ៉ាំ) is a traditional Khmer musical dance: a light-hearted, comedic processional form combining percussive rhythms, exaggerated movements, call-and-response singing and improvisation (Wikipedia; Dance in Cambodia). Male drummers play brightly decorated long drums (skor chhayam) with wooden clappers (krab) and cymbals, while comically painted male dancers flirt with a central graceful female dancer who ignores them; bystanders clap and sing along. It is performed at holidays, especially Khmer New Year, often to lead ceremonial processions.
card.insight: Chhayam is regarded as a "pure Khmer" entertainment dance believed to bring good luck and happiness; it leads festival processions at Chaul Chnam Thmey and has been sustained in diaspora communities (e.g., Long Beach and Lowell, USA) to pass Khmer heritage to younger generations (Dance in Cambodia, Wikipedia).
